title: The Law, the Prophets and the Psalms

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: If we try to earn our righteousness by laws in stone engraved,
Then the power of sin will reign in us; we’re bound, by law enslaved.
If our lips confess that Jesus is our saviour and our Lord,
And our hearts believe God raised him up; we’re saved, by grace: restored.

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: All the prophets, Moses, Samuel, proclaimed the saviour’s day,
So let’s hear the words they prophesied and turn from wicked ways.
They had searched and sought so carefully and spoke of coming grace,
And they asked about his suffering and when he’d take his place.

parts.label: Chorus
lines: All the prophets, all the psalms, and all the words of Moses’ law
Must all be fulfilled in Jesus, as the faithful long foresaw.
Come and open up your minds to find the saviour there concealed,
And in every word of Scripture see the son of God revealed.

parts.label: Verse 3
lines: In the second psalm the Father says to him, “You are my son”,
And another says, “The holy one won’t see corruption”,
Now we bring the good news promised to the fathers: God be praised!
To their children God has kept his word, for Jesus Christ is raised.

And they shall build houses and inhabit them
And they shall plant vineyards and eat their fruit
They shall not build and another inhabit
They shall not plant and another eat
For as the days of a tree are the days of my people
And mine elect shall long enjoy the works of their hands

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: I will extol my God, my King, and I will bless your name for ever and ever. (×3)
I will extol my God, my King: every day I will bless you.

parts.label: Chorus
lines: And we will praise your name forever:
Great is the LORD,
And his greatness is unsearchable,
Greatly to be praised.

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: One generation shall tell another, praising your works and mighty acts;
I’ll meditate on your glorious splendour, declaring works of majesty.

parts.label: Chorus
lines: And we will praise your name forever:
Great is the LORD (we will extol our God),
And his greatness is unsearchable,
Greatly to be praised (we will extol our God).

parts.label: Verse 3
lines: The LORD is gracious, full of compassion, slow to anger, great in mercy;
All who are bowed down, all those who fall, the LORD upholds and raises all.
Your saints shall bless you, speak of your kingdom, and of its glorious majesty;
It’s everlasting, like your dominion: let all men know the glory.

parts.label: Verse 4
lines: The LORD is righteous in all his ways,
Gracious in all his works, near to all who obey.
The LORD is near to all those who call,
Fulfilling the desire of those who fear in awe.
He hears and saves them, he hears their cry;
My mouth shall speak of him, my praise will never die.
Forever and ever. (×8)

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: I called in my distress to Yahweh, and he answered me.
From the depths of the grave I cried, you heard my voice.
And you cast me to the deep, to the heart of the seas,
and floods encircled me: your waves passed over me.

parts.label: Chorus
lines: And I said, I am cast from your eyes;
Yet I will look again
Towards your holy temple
To your holy temple

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: Water compassed me round, unto the soul:
The depth encircled me, weeds were wrapped round my head.
To the bottom of the mountains I went down;
The earth beneath barred me forever

parts.label: Chorus 2
lines: But you brought my life up from the pit,
Yahweh my God.
When my soul fainted
I remembered Yahweh
and my prayer rose up to you
to your holy temple,
to your holy temple.
Be ye doers of the word
Not hearers only
Deceiving yourselves

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: Oh the Ninevites – they’re so, so bad,
The things that they’ve done make me so, so mad.
So when God called me and said, “Go preach to them,”
I said, “I’d rather see them die than turn to God again.”

parts.label: Chorus
lines: So I’ll run, run, run in the opposite way,
Yes, I’ll run, run, run for the rest of the day.
I’m gonna run, run, run, going out to sea,
I’m gonna run, run, run: God will never find me.

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh, the problem is, God is loving and good;
He will forgive their sins, but I don’t think he should.
I just don’t want to know, don’t want to see God forgive:
Ninevites deserve to die, oh no, they don’t deserve to live!

title: God listens to our prayers
note: Call and answer: one or two people sing each line of the verses, then everyone sings it back. The “pray to him” parts are spoken rather than sung.

No matter what you’ve done,
No matter how deep you fall,
Don’t matter what’s going on.

parts.label: Chorus
lines: So pray to him, tell him what’s going on;
Pray to him when you’ve fallen on your bum;
Pray to him when life just ain’t no fun;
Pray to the Lord.

parts.label: Chorus 2
lines: So pray to him, he will listen to your prayer;
Pray to him, he knows your every hair;
Pray to him, he really, really cares;
Pray to the Lord.

parts.label: Verse 2

When you’re in a fish’s belly,

title: Goliath
note: Goliath sings this to taunt Israel, so the boys sing it; everyone joins in on the last line.

parts.label: Verse 1
lines: Oh, I’m strong, oh, I’m big,
You couldn’t beat me for a million quid!

parts.label: Chorus
lines: I’m the champion of champions, I’m the greatest of all,
You’ll never beat me ’cos I’m nine foot tall! (×2)

parts.label: Verse 2
lines: Bring someone to fight me – did you hear what I said?
Bring him right now and I’ll squish his head!
Oh, I’ll pull off his arms and I’ll crush his bones,
’Cos I’m stronger than iron and stone!

parts.label: Chorus
lines: I’m the champion of champions, I’m the greatest of all,
